sentences.en: Anatole with his swaggering air strode up to the window.

sentences.en: The quality of both the song and video are very impressive with Century Man doing swaggering, arrogant indie rock well.

sentences.en: Apartment are more sure of themselves, swaggering confidently around stage.

sentences.en: As he well expected, he then came under a barrage of abuse, and was swaggering about, reveling in the attention.

sentences.en: Sonic Reducer is a swaggering monster of a punk song.

sentences.en: Osunlade does n't disappoint as he regales the listener with his swaggering, slinky style.

sentences.en: Like every Manc band worth their salt they also have their full quota of swaggering arrogance.
sentences.vi: Giống như mọi ban nhạc Manc đáng giá muối của họ, họ cũng có đầy đủ hạn ngạch của sự kiêu ngạo ngông cuồng.

sentences.en: Cavalier in English was early applied in a contemptuous sense to an overbearing swashbuckler - a roisterer or swaggering gallant.
sentences.vi: Ung dung trong tiếng Anh sớm được áp dụng với nghĩa khinh thường cho một kẻ hống hách hống hách - một kẻ ngang tàng hoặc hào hiệp vênh váo.

sentences.en: John Steed was an arrogant, swaggering young man.
